input: Write a letter to my future self for ten years

gold.taskTitle: Write a Letter to Your Future Self in Ten Years
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to write a heartfelt, personal letter addressed to themselves ten years into the future.

questions.title: What is the main purpose or tone of this letter?
questions.description: Understand whether the letter is meant to be reflective, motivational, nostalgic, or a mix of these.

questions.title: What major life areas do you want to address?
questions.description: Identify specific themes such as career, relationships, health, finances, or personal growth.

questions.title: What are you currently proud of that you want to remember?
questions.description: Capture present achievements or moments the user wants their future self to look back on.

questions.title: What specific goals or dreams are you hoping came true?
questions.description: Identify the hopes and aspirations the user wants to check in on in ten years.

questions.title: What struggles or fears do you want to speak to?
questions.description: Understand current challenges the user wants to acknowledge or give encouragement about.

questions.title: How long and detailed should this letter be?
questions.description: Determine the desired length, such as a short heartfelt note, a medium letter, or a long detailed reflection.

questions.title: How do you plan to preserve or deliver this letter?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a digital version, a printed copy, or plans to use a service like FutureMe.
